card.text: F6 dwarf in Telescopium ringed by a bright belt of debris 48 parsecs away.

sources.label: Gáspár et al. 2026
sources.quote: five disk systems previously identified to be exceptionally bright at optical wavelengths (HD 10647, HD 32297, HD 61005, HD 107146, and HD 181327)

introduction.text: HD 181327 is an F-type dwarf 48 parsecs away. A bright ring of colliding debris surrounds it, which JWST/NIRCam imaged behind its coronagraphs in six filters.

sources.label: Gáspár et al. 2026
sources.quote: designed to observe five disk systems previously identified to be exceptionally bright at optical wavelengths (HD 10647, HD 32297, HD 61005, HD 107146, and HD 181327) with six filters using the NIRCam coronagraphs
